Metadata.title: SpiderAML — crypto address screening
Metadata.description: Check a crypto address before sending: sanctions lists, hacks, phishing, suspicious activity. Token analysis and large transfers.

Footer.tagline: Crypto address screening from open and official data

Common.disclaimer: Scores are automatic. Not legal advice and not an accusation.
Common.searchPlaceholder: Wallet or token address: 0x… or T…

sanctioned.name: Sanctions list
sanctioned.about: Official sanctions list. Sending may break the law.

exploit.name: Hack or theft
exploit.about: Linked to a hack or theft.

phishing.name: Phishing
phishing.about: Stole money: fake site, one signature — wallet empty.

scam.name: Suspicious activity
scam.about: User complaints or a flag in open databases.

mixer.name: Mixer
mixer.about: Hides where the money came from. Exchanges freeze such coins.

info.name: Label
info.about: Who owns it, per blockchain explorers.

low.title: Low risk
low.summary: This address is not on any risk lists we know.
advice: Not a guarantee: new schemes appear daily.
For a large amount, send a test transfer.

medium.title: Some risk signals
medium.summary: There are isolated warning signs. That is not a verdict yet — look into what explains them.

high.title: High risk
high.summary: Serious flags in open databases. We advise against sending money.

critical.title: Critical risk
critical.summary: The address is on a sanctions list. Or it is linked to a hack, theft or phishing.
advice: Already sent? Save the hash and contact support.

concentration.name: Held by a few
concentration.about: One large sale can crash the price.

liquidity.name: Liquidity
liquidity.about: Little money in pools — hard to sell without losses.

verified.name: Open contract code
verified.about: Code not published — nothing to review.

admin.name: Owner privileges
admin.about: The owner can change the token rules.

listing.name: Market presence
listing.about: Whether it trades and has data.

Note.tron_limited: Tron: lists and open databases only, no transfers.

Errors.INVALID_ADDRESS: This does not look like an address. Use a 0x… address (Ethereum, BNB and others) or T… (Tron).
Errors.NOT_A_CONTRACT: There is no contract at this address on the selected network. Check the network or paste a token address.
Errors.UNSUPPORTED: This contract does not look like a token — this analysis is unavailable for it.
Errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a minute.
Errors.CONFIG_MISSING: This network is not connected yet.
Errors.UNAVAILABLE: The data service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
